title: PluginManifest
description:
Canonical platform contract. Endpoint addresses, secrets and tenant state are
supplied by the host; they must never be embedded in a published manifest.

admin.description:
The management surface (Admin Extension Contract), see
[`crate::admin::PluginAdmin`].

assets.description:
Digest table of the package's `assets/` files, covered by the
publisher signature (see [`crate::package`]).

displayNameI18n.description:
Publisher-owned display names per locale (`zh-CN`, `en-US`): at most
16 entries of 160 UTF-8 bytes each. Hosts use `displayName` when the
requested language is unavailable.

eventSubscriptions.description: Core observations delivered asynchronously, after approval of their permissions/scopes.

features.description:
What an application can publish separately. A plugin with user
operations declares at least one (see [`PluginFeature`]).

oneOf.description: Tenant staff (and platform staff acting for the tenant).
Platform staff only.

emit.description: Events the plugin emits (each one of the manifest's `events`).

subscribe.description: Events the plugin wants; only the shape is declared, Core does not deliver them yet.

configurationCarryOver.description:
An upgrade keeps the tenant configuration (new keys take their default,
removed keys are dropped and audited). Default true.

from.description: Semantic version range of the installed version it upgrades.

reversible.description: `false`: once run, the platform refuses to enable an older version.

to.description: The version it upgrades to; at most this manifest's version.

oneOf.description:
The platform disables the plugin, runs the migration, waits for the
runtime ACK, then enables it.
Runs while the plugin serves.

pages.description: A workspace's independently authorized pages. Empty keeps a single-page entry.

parentPage.description: Context page whose toolbar offers this auxiliary page; never grants access.

auditTarget.description:
JSON pointer into the operation input naming the audited target (the
poll id of a close).

permission.description: One of [`PluginAdmin::permissions`]: the staff ticket must carry its code.

requiresReason.description:
The console asks the staff member for a reason; Core records it in the
audit with the call.

scope.description: Authority required for this operation. An application grant never grants organization work.

document.description:
Rendered with the generic plugin renderer; every action, rows source
and the detail call admin operations only.

permission.description: One of [`PluginAdmin::permissions`]: needed to see the page.

oneOf.description: A rows block (filters, row actions, paging) and an optional detail.
A document over one result; no rows.
Action forms; no rows.
Kit whitelisted widgets ([`AdminWidgetKind`]).

defaultRoles.description:
Built-in roles the platform grants it to on install (`org_owner`, …);
tenants may assign it to other roles.

groupLabels.description: Headings of the `group` keys the hints use.

uiHints.description:
Presentation of the configuration form generated from
`configurationSchema`, by top-level property.

description.description: The field's help by locale, as `label` for the schema `description`.

fields.description:
Hints of the properties of an object field, or of the items of an
array of objects.

group.description: Group key the form puts the field under (`[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`).

label.description:
The field's name by locale. Takes the place of the schema `title`,
which has one language; a locale it does not hold falls back to the
title.

options.description: Labels of the schema's enumerated values, by value and locale.

reference.description:
The options of the field, read with the viewer's own permission (see
[`UiReference`]). `parents` name properties next to the field.

widget.description: Absent: the form picks the control from the schema type.

check.description:
An admin `query` operation that reports what uninstalling would leave
behind: `{blockers: [..], warnings: [..]}`. Plugins holding user assets
or long transactions declare it; the platform calls it first.

export.description:
The plugin implements the data export protocol (`flare.plugin.data.v1`),
so tenants can export before and for a while after uninstalling.

path.description:
JSON pointer into its result: a number (`kit:stat`) or an array of
`{atMs, value}` points (`kit:chart.timeseries`).

AdminWidgetKind.description: A dashboard widget from the kit's whitelist; never plugin code.

configuration.description:
A boolean top-level property of `configurationSchema` marked
client-visible. Its value follows the switch; the plugin enforces it.

contributions.description: Ids of client contributions the catalog leaves out.

operations.description: Wire ids of user operations and asynchronous Core event callbacks.

serviceOperations.description:
Wire ids of `user` mode service operations. `recovery` mode is never
gated: closing a payment must not stop its reconciliation.

oneOf.description:
Read: which of up to 50 user ids are members of the bound conversation
([`ResourceRequest::ConversationMembersCheck`], [`MembersCheckView`]).

Write: publish [`SharedState`] for an entity bound to a message of the
calling plugin. Requested with [`ResourceWriteRequest`].

Write: deliver a non-durable packet to online devices of members of one
conversation. Requested with [`ResourceWriteRequest::RealtimeDeliver`].
May change state; invoked on a user gesture or by the plugin's own flow.
Reads only; safe for hosts to call in the background.

operations.description:
The admin operations, each a declared capability operation that no
client contribution uses.

permissions.description:
Staff permissions of this plugin, granted as
[`crate::invocation::plugin_permission`] codes
(`plugin:<pluginId>:<id>`).

PluginAsset.description:
One file of a package's `assets/`. The table is part of the signed
manifest, so changing a file fails verification.

PluginFeature.description:
One switch an application publishes on its own, with the global key
`<pluginId>.<id>`. Operation, service operation and contribution gates are
enforced by Core and never reach the plugin process. A configuration gate
is for behaviour that shares one operation (a voice and a video call are
the same `start`): the plugin reads the key from its effective configuration.

An operation may belong to several features; closing any of them closes it.
A feature the application has not published is closed.

defaultEnabled.description:
Whether the publishing flow preselects the feature. Not a runtime
default: an unpublished feature stays closed.

description.description: What publishing or closing the feature changes, per locale.

id.description: Relative to the capability id; the wire operation is `<capability>.<id>`.

mode.description:
`query` declares that the operation only reads: hosts may call it in
the background without a user gesture (a card's `viewerState`, an
account entry's `summary`). Default `command`. The plugin still
authorizes every call; the mode only says what a host may schedule.

command.description:
Page commands persist before dispatch. Retry/ack use the original
authenticated journal record; a host cannot replace an unknown result.

continuation.description: Navigate only after a verified successful operation response.

form.description:
Ids of document inputs the host collects first (`0..=16`, operation
targets only); their validated values join the action input under their
ids, which must not repeat a declared input name.

hiddenWhen.description:
Presentation only: the action is omitted when any condition matches. The
plugin still authorizes every invocation; hiding is never a permission.

placement.description:
Where the host shows the action: the button row (default) or the
card's overflow menu (⋯). A resolved view lists them apart
([`ResolvedPluginView::actions`], [`ResolvedPluginView::menu_actions`]);
`hiddenWhen` applies to both. An action a block owns (a choices
submit, a row action) is never placed in the menu.

UiAudience.description:
Who sees a composer-action entry. An empty list admits everyone; roles apply
in group conversations only.

UiBlock.description:
A display block, tagged by `kind`. Every kind may carry `hiddenWhen`
conditions that leave it out of the resolved view.

oneOf.description:
Text, multi-line and collapsible. Exactly one of `text` (literal, at most
2000 bytes, translated through `texts`) and `path` (a scalar in the data,
shown up to 4000 characters).

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

maxLines.description: Lines shown collapsed (`1..=20`); the host offers "expand" beyond them.

oneOf.description:
Label/value rows, with the same rules as the document's `fields`
(`1..=16`); value labels are translated through `texts`.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description:
A list of options, positional: option `i` has count `counts[i]`, and the
selection is a list of indices. Choosing binds `action`, whose input gets
`{<inputName>: [indices]}` in addition to its declared input. The options
come from the data (`optionsPath`) or are declared (`options`), exactly
one of the two.

action.description:
Id of a document action with an operation target. The action is not
listed with the card's buttons; the block owns it.

closedWhen.description:
Closed when any condition matches (`0..=4`): results shown per
`showResults`, no choosing.

countsPath.description:
Array of non-negative integers aligned with the options; missing items
count 0.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

inputName.description:
Action input name of the selection (default `selection`); must not
collide with the action's declared input or form.

labelPath.description: Inside an option object: its label (`optionsPath` only).

maxSelectionsPath.description:
A multiple choice's limit: the most options the viewer may choose, a
positive integer (capped at the option count). Absent, zero or not a
number: no limit beyond the options. Ignored on a single choice.

multiplePath.description: Truthy (true, non-zero, "true") for a multiple choice; single otherwise.

options.description:
Declared options (`1..=50`), such as accept / maybe / decline; labels
are translated through `texts`. Counts and the selection are still read
from their paths, by position.

optionsPath.description:
Array of option labels (scalars), or of objects read with `labelPath`.
`1..=50` options, each with a non-blank label, or the block is not shown.

selectedPath.description:
The viewer's choice: an array of indices, or one index (usually local
state, such as `/mySelection`).

totalPath.description:
Denominator of the percentages (such as voter count); the sum of counts
when absent.

oneOf.description:
Entries (solitaire lines, comments, voters). The first `limit` are shown;
when the total is larger and the contribution offers its detail, the host
offers "view all", which opens that detail (`more`). Without a detail, with
the detail hidden by its `hiddenWhen`, and inside the detail document
itself, `more` is false.

Numbering: with `numbered` (the default) kits show each entry's `index`;
with `numbered: false` they show no position numbers at all.

Grouping (`groupPath`): entries are grouped by the scalar at `groupPath`
inside each entry, in data order: a new group starts wherever that key
differs from the previous entry's (so the plugin sends entries already
ordered by group, such as voters by option). The first entry of each group
carries the group header ([`ResolvedUiEntry::group`]): its key, its label
(`groupLabelPath`, else the key), and when given its count
(`groupCountPath`, such as the option's votes) and total
(`groupTotalPath`, such as all votes) with the percentage. In a grouped
block `index` restarts at 1 in each group, and an entry without a key at
`groupPath` is not shown. Kits render one flat list and put a header row
before every entry that has `group`.

countPath.description: Total number of entries when the data holds only the latest ones.

emptyText.description: Shown when the list is present but empty.

groupCountPath.description:
Inside an entry: its group's count, a non-negative integer. Requires
`groupPath`.

groupLabelPath.description:
Inside an entry: its group's label (the key when absent or blank).
Read from the first entry of each group; requires `groupPath`.

groupPath.description: Inside an entry: its group key (a scalar). Turns grouping on.

groupTotalPath.description:
Inside an entry: the denominator of the group percentages, a
non-negative integer. Requires `groupPath`.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

itemsPath.description:
Array of entries: objects read with the paths below, or strings. A
string (or another scalar) is the entry text when `textPath` is
absent, so a string array such as the latest lines kept in shared
state renders as is.

textPath.description:
Inside an entry object: its text. When set, an entry that is not an
object has nothing to show and is skipped.

userIdsPath.description:
Array of user ids aligned with the entries by position (a top-level
path, such as `/lineUserIds` beside `/lines`). An entry without a user
of its own (a string entry, or no value at `userPath`) takes the id at
its position, when that is a valid user id.

userPath.description:
User id inside an entry; the host resolves avatar (and name, when
`namePath` is absent).

valueLabels.description:
A badge for each entry: an enumerated value inside the entry mapped to
a label and a tone (a ledger line's kind).

oneOf.description:
Avatar stacks with counts, optionally grouped by status (confirmed and not
yet confirmed).

groups.description: `1..=4` groups; a group whose paths are both missing is not shown.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description:
A badge: the scalar at `path` mapped to a label and a tone; an unmapped
value is shown as sent, neutral.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description: Done out of total (non-negative integers), with the percentage.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description:
An instant or a range in epoch milliseconds (integer or digit string). The
host formats it in the viewer's locale and time zone; with `countdown` it
counts down to the end (or to the instant) while that is in the future.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.
Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description:
Secondary text (an anonymity notice). Exactly one of `text` and `path`, as
for a text block.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

oneOf.description: Page and admin page (`admin.pages`) documents only.

actions.description:
`0..=4` ids of document actions with operation or page targets (an
admin page's: operation targets only). Their `hiddenWhen` and declared
input read the row; the block owns them. A page target opens that page
with the row's bound input as its arguments.

filters.description:
Ids of the document inputs that are filters (`0..=16`, unique). Absent:
every input is a filter; `[]`: none is.

hiddenWhen.description:
Not shown when any condition matches (`0..=4`). Unlike the row
actions' conditions these read the page (the source result), not a row.

keyPath.description: Inside a row: its stable key (scalar); rows without one are skipped.

path.description: Array of row objects; at most 100 are resolved.

source.description: Wire operation declared by the plugin.

valueLabels.description:
A badge for each row, as for entries ([`UiValueLabels`], read inside
the row).

oneOf.description: Admin page (`admin.pages`) documents only.

action.description: Id of a document action with an operation target; the block owns it.

hiddenWhen.description: Not shown when any condition (`0..=4`) matches the resolved data.

idPath.description: Inside an item: its stable id (scalar); items without one are skipped.

itemsPath.description: Array of item objects; at most 16 are resolved.

labelPath.description: Inside an item: what the viewer reads it as.

mediaTypePath.description: Inside an item: its media type (`image/jpeg`).

reasonInput.description:
One of the action's `form` inputs. Together with `inputName` they are
all of its form: the host collects nothing else.

UiChoiceOption.description: A declared option of a choices block.

valueFormat.description:
How the value reads, as for a field; its paths read the row. Takes the
place of `format` and `values`, which stay at their defaults.

values.description: Labels for enumerated cell values (`0..=32`), translated through `texts`.

oneOf.description: Epoch milliseconds; the host formats it.

UiCondition.description:
A data-only test on the data the document is resolved against (for a row
action, on the row). No expressions: a value list, the viewer, presence, or
all of a few such tests. Exactly one of `anyOf`, `viewer`, `exists` and
`allOf` is given.

allOf.description:
Matches when every one of these conditions matches (`1..=4`, each with
its own `path`). One level only: they may not hold `allOf` themselves.

anyOf.description: Matches when the value (text, number or bool) is one of these.

exists.description:
Matches when the value is present and not empty (null, "", [] and {}
are empty; false and 0 are present).

negate.description:
Inverts the match. For `anyOf` and `viewer` a missing value never
matches either way, so older payloads without the path keep the action;
a negated `exists` matches a missing value; a negated `allOf` matches
when not every condition matches (each still follows its own rules).

path.description:
The value `anyOf`, `viewer` and `exists` test; required with them and
absent with `allOf`.

viewer.description: Matches when the viewer is the value, or an element of an array value.

audience.description:
composer-action only: who sees the entry. Presentation only; the
plugin still authorizes every invocation.

availability.description:
composer-action only: a `query` whose result says whether the entry
can be used now (see [`crate::ui::UiEntryAvailability`]). Without it
the entry is always listed.

detail.description:
message-content only: the "view all" document and the operation that
returns its data.

entityLifecycle.description:
message-content only, with `entityPath`: the operation Core calls
with a platform system ticket when the card bound to an entity goes
away (see [`UiEntityLifecycle`]). A card with `entityPath` and no
`unbound` operation is valid; [`PluginManifest::warnings`] reports it.

entityPath.description:
message-content only: JSON pointer into the card payload whose value
(string or integer) is the plugin entity id, e.g. `/pollId`. Core binds
`(tenant, pluginId, entity)` to the message when it is stored, which is
what lets the plugin publish [`crate::state::SharedState`] for it.

forwardable.description:
message-content only: whether hosts offer "forward" on this card
(default false: plugin cards are bound to their conversation).

icon.description:
Name in the design kit's icon registry. Presentation only: a kit that
does not know the name shows its generic plugin icon.

order.description:
Ascending position among entries of the same kind (default 1000). Hosts
list plugin entries after their built-in ones; ties sort by title.

preview.description:
Sample data the marketplace renders this contribution with: an object
of at most [`MAX_UI_PREVIEW_BYTES`]. Never read at run time; hosts
leave it out of the client catalog.

source.description:
page only: the `query` operation whose result the page document is
resolved against, its input bound from the page arguments, and its
paging (see [`crate::ui::UiPageSource`]).

summary.description:
account-entry only: a scalar read from a `query` operation result and
shown as the entry's subtitle (a wallet balance). Hosts call it on
demand; listing entries never calls it.

viewerState.description:
message-content only: the viewer's own layer of the card, read in the
background by the core SDK while the card is presented (see
[`crate::ui::UiViewerState`]). Its operation must be a declared
`query`.

oneOf.description:
An entry of the "Me" (account) screen, such as a wallet: its title,
translations and target come from its document, which holds no fields,
blocks or inputs and exactly one action targeting a `page`
contribution of the same plugin. `icon` and `order` place it; an
optional `summary` names a `query` whose result gives a subtitle.

UiDetail.description:
The "view all" document of a message-content contribution or of an admin
page (`admin.pages`).
The host invokes `operation` with `input` bound from the card data (or, on
an admin page, from the row), then resolves `document` against the result
`data` and shows it in a sheet. A detail document has no rows block and no
detail of its own.

Paging (`cursorPath`): the first page is requested with the bound input
alone; the resolved view carries the cursor of the next page as
`nextCursor`, and the host requests that page with the same input plus
`cursor` ([`Self::page_input`]), resolves it against the same document and
appends it ([`ResolvedPluginView::append_page`]). No `nextCursor` means
the last page.

cursorPath.description:
The cursor of the next page in the detail result: a non-blank scalar of
at most 256 bytes without control characters; anything else, or no
value, ends paging. When set, `input` may not bind `cursor`.

hiddenWhen.description:
The detail is not offered while any condition matches (`0..=4`), read
on the data the contribution's document is resolved against: the
merged card data, or an admin page's source result (not a row). The
resolved view then has `detail: false`, entries blocks report no
`more` (as without a detail), and rows carry no `detailInput`.
Presentation only: the detail operation still authorizes every call.

operation.description: Wire operation declared by the plugin.

inputs.description:
Form inputs referenced by action forms, and the filters of the rows
block of a page or an admin page (`admin.pages`): its `filters`, or
every input when it lists none (`0..=16`).

presentation.description:
Optional compiled-in design-kit renderer. Contains inert display data
and references to this document's actions, never executable code.

UiEntityLifecycle.description:
What Core tells a plugin about the card bound to one of its entities.

Core invokes `unbound` with a platform system ticket (its own call domain,
verified by the plugin host; never a user ticket) and the input
`{entity, reason, serverMsgId?}`, `reason` one of
[`UNBOUND_REASON_RECALLED`] (the bound card was recalled) and
[`UNBOUND_REASON_POST_FAILED`] (the platform could not post the card).
Delivery is at least once: plugins handle it idempotently per entity (a
poll is cancelled, a red packet refunded at once).

unbound.description: Wire operation declared by the plugin.

UiEntryAvailability.description:
Whether a composer entry can be used now, as the plugin service says: the
boolean at `path` in the result of `operation` (a declared `query` taking
no input). For an entry whose capability depends on the deployment, such
as payments that need an identity service. Hosts list the entry only when
that value is `true`; a failed, slow or malformed answer hides it.
Presentation only: the plugin still refuses the invocation itself.

UiEntrySummary.description:
The subtitle of an account entry: the scalar at `path` in the result of
`operation` (a declared `query` taking no input), such as a balance text.

format.description: How the value reads. The resolved field keeps its plain text either way.

values.description: Display labels for enumerated values (a status shown as words, not as its wire value).

UiFieldFormat.description:
How a field or a column reads, tagged by `kind`. Paths read the object the
field reads: the resolved data for a field, the row for a column.

oneOf.description:
An integer amount in minor units, as a number or a digit string. The scale
comes from `scale` or `scalePath`. Without either, or when the path holds
no scale, the host looks the asset at `assetPath` up in what it already
knows; until then the value stays the minor amount. At least one of the
three is set, and at most one of `scale` and `scalePath`.

Labels of an enumerated value (`1..=64`, keys `1..=64` bytes), translated
through `texts`. An unmapped value is shown as sent.

A user id: the host shows the person. A staff actor is written
[`STAFF_ACTOR_PREFIX`]`<id>`; the host gets the bare id.
An id shown through its label, read beside it at `labelPath`.
Epoch milliseconds: the host formats the instant.

accept.description: Exact MIME types, without wildcards or parameters.

purpose.description: Plugin-owned purpose, pinned by the declaration, never by the form.

UiInput.description: A form input. Fields that do not apply to `kind` are rejected.

choices.description:
select: `1..=1024` choices. options: `0..=1024`; when present the items
are picked from them instead of typed.

choicesPath.description:
Read bounded select choices from the authenticated source projection.
Removed before rendering; every host consumes the same resolved list.

default.description:
Initial value of the input's type; options may hold empty placeholder
items. Not allowed on members.

defaultPath.description:
Initial value read from the card data instead (for editing an existing
entry); falls back to `default` when absent or of the wrong type.

id.description:
The key of the value in the action input: `[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}`, unique
in the document.

max.description: number: largest value. options (`<= 50`), members (`<= 500`): most items.

maxLength.description:
Characters: text (`1..=1024`, default 256), textarea (`1..=8000`,
default 2000), options per item (`1..=256`, default 100).

maxPath.description:
options and members only: the most items read from the data the
document is resolved against instead (a composer form's
`/config/<key>`). When it holds a positive integer the resolved input's
`max` is that integer, capped at 50 or 500; it keeps the declared `max`
when the value is absent, not such an integer, or would make the input
invalid (below `min`, or below the item count of `default`).

min.description: number: smallest value. options, members: fewest items (integer).

reference.description:
select and options only, instead of `choices`: the host reads the
choices with the viewer's own permission. Admin pages only. The value
is checked for shape here; the plugin decides whether it exists.

required.description: A value is required: non-blank text, at least one item.

showWhen.description:
Hosts seed visible defaults once. Every controller value change clears
all dependants, including uploads still visible under the new value.

oneOf.description: One line of text; value is a string.
Secret text: no default, data binding or durable page command.
Multi-line text; value is a string (newlines allowed).
Value is a JSON number within `min..=max`.
Value is a boolean; never `required`.
Value is the `value` of one of `choices`.

Value is an instant in epoch milliseconds (integer); the host picks it
in the viewer's time zone.

An editable list of option texts; value is an array of strings, item
count within `min..=max`, each item non-empty and unique.

Conversation members picked from the list the host provides; value is
an array of user ids, count within `min..=max`. `max: 1` is a single pick.
One completed private plugin upload; value is exactly `{fileId}`.

UiInputShowWhen.description:
Dynamic form visibility reads only an earlier unconditional Select of the
same collected form. Page data and arbitrary expressions are not involved.

oneOf.description: Query the immutable authenticated intent; never replay its write.

UiPageSource.description:
The data a `page` contribution is resolved against: the result `data` of
a declared `query` operation. A page is opened with arguments, the input
the opening action bound (a page target's payload; `{}` from an account
entry). `input` names operation inputs and the JSON pointers into those
arguments they are read from; one whose pointer finds nothing is left
out, so an argument is optional.

Paging follows the detail convention ([`UiDetail`]): with `cursorPath`
the resolved page carries `nextCursor`, the next page is requested with
the same input plus `cursor` ([`Self::page_input`]) and appended with
[`ResolvedPluginView::append_page`]. A page without a source resolves
against its arguments.

commandSlot.description:
SDK-local journal projection, merged under `journal` after the source
query. Scoped to the signed-in tenant/user; never supplied by a server.

cursorPath.description:
The cursor of the next page in the result, as for a detail. When set,
`input` may not bind `cursor`.

operation.description: Wire operation declared by the plugin with `mode: "query"`.

actionId.description:
Execute this declared, form-free durable action after the initiating
operation succeeds. Never executed when a page is read or opened.

countPath.description:
The group size when the data lists only some of its users; the length
of the users array otherwise. At least one of the two paths is set.

usersPath.description: Array of user ids; the host resolves avatars.

UiReference.description:
Where a select input or a configuration field takes its options from: an
admin `query` operation of this plugin, or of `plugin`, one of its declared
dependencies.

Each read calls `operation` with `params`, the values of `parents`, the
viewer's `search` text, `cursor` and `selected` (the value already chosen,
so it can be named when it is not on the first page). The operation answers
`{items: [..], nextCursor?, selected?}`; `valuePath` and `labelPath` read
inside an item and inside `selected`.

The read runs under the viewer's own permission on the plugin that owns the
operation. A viewer without it gets a disabled control: this plugin's
permissions never read for them.

params.description: Fixed scalar inputs of the operation (`0..=8`).

parents.description:
Operation inputs taken from sibling controls (`0..=4`), by operation
input name: the id of an input of the same document, or a property next
to the configuration field. The control stays disabled until each holds
a value.

plugin.description: The plugin that owns `operation`; this plugin when absent.

search.description: Operation input of the viewer's search text. Absent: no search box.

UiRowsPresentation.description: How a host draws a rows block. A host that cannot draw cards draws the table.

oneOf.description:
One card per row: the first column is the title, the second the
description, the others its details, the row actions its control.

UiShowResults.description: When a choices block shows counts.

oneOf.description: Always (a public poll).
Once the viewer has chosen, or once closed.
Only once closed.

UiTone.description: Semantic color of a badge, note or people group; kits map it to tokens.

fields.description:
One label per document field, in order (empty when the document has
no fields).

texts.description:
Every other text of the document, keyed by its source text: block
labels and literals, value labels of blocks and columns, input labels,
placeholders and choices, action confirmations. A text without an entry
is shown as declared.

values.description: Display labels for enumerated field values, keyed by field path.

UiValueLabels.description:
Labels for an enumerated value inside each entry or row, shown as that
item's badge: the scalar at `path` (inside the item) mapped to a label,
translated through `texts`, and a tone. An unmapped value is shown as
sent, neutral, as in a status block; an item without a value has no
badge. `1..=32` values, keys `1..=64` bytes.

UiViewerRefresh.description: When the core SDK reads a card's [`UiViewerState`].

oneOf.description:
Presenting the card reads it when the viewer layer is missing or stale
(computed from an older shared version).

A newer shared version of a card presented recently reads it again,
without waiting for the host to present the card.

UiViewerState.description:
The viewer's own layer of a message-content card: what only this viewer
may see or do (`hasVoted`, `canClose`, counts visible to them alone). The
core SDK schedules it; hosts and kits write no call logic.

The SDK calls `operation` (a declared `query`) with `input` bound from the
card payload under its shared layer (never the local layer, so the result
never feeds its own request), when [`refreshOn`](Self::refresh_on) says
so, at most once per `minIntervalMs` per card, one call in flight per
card, with exponential backoff after failures, only for presented cards,
and never across a session change. The result `data` (an object) is
overlaid on the card's local layer (top-level keys, null removes one) and
stored with [`PluginMessageState::based_on_version`] taken from the
result's `basedOnVersion` (a non-negative integer, at most the shared
version seen when the call was made) or else that seen version. A result
may also carry `refreshOn`
to narrow the triggers for that card ([`Self::result_refresh_on`]); the
keys `basedOnVersion` and `refreshOn` are not stored as values.

input.description: Input names to JSON pointers into the card data (`0..=32`).

minIntervalMs.description:
Calls per card at most once per this many milliseconds
(`1000..=3600000`).

operation.description: Wire operation declared by the plugin, mode `query`.
